Radioactive uranium doesn’t really have a “life support” ring to it, yet that’s just what it is for some intraterrestrials. Arsenic is poisonous to humans and many other creatures, but intraterrestrials respire it too, essentially cleaning up our toxic pollution. Gold is not very chemically reactive — that’s why humans use it in currency and jewelry. Yet there are microbes that consume it. 20/4/25LinkFile
